text:
Rita: Quick thread  planning a lightweight OSS launch for a new tutorial repo 'inference-playbook'. Goals: blog launch, a short livestream tutorial, and a benchmark spotlight. Need to coordinate owners.

Omar: can we make the tutorial single-file to reduce friction? maybe `playbook/run.sh` that spins up everything with a single command. Also add a `--no-gpu` flag.

Tess: timeline? prefer 2-week runway: week 1 content + code, week 2 rehearsals + outreach. Live session on the last Thu of the month.

Hannah: inbound setup: we'll use HubSpot form `hs_playbook_launch` with field `enterprise_trial_interest`. Also add a hidden `utm_source=community`. We'll pass leads to #sales-inbound when `enterprise_trial_interest=true`.

Rita: messaging draft for blog lead: 'inference-playbook: simple, reproducible tutorial for building inference into apps. Includes a live demo and a reproducible benchmark to show real-world costs.'

Omar: code owner notes: I'll add `playbook/quickstart.sh`, `bench/bench.py`, and a sample `dockerfile.cpu`. Will create PR tonight.

Tess: webinar outline: 5m intro, 20m code walk-through, 10m benchmarking demo, 15m Q&A. Include a 5-minute live contributor onboarding to show how to open a PR with a `good-first-issue`.

Hannah: landing page flow: landing -> HS form -> auto-tag `campaign=playbook_launch_apr` -> webhook -> #marketing-notify. We'll only ping #sales-inbound for enterprise interest.

Rita: social hooks (short):
- 'New tutorial: inference-playbook  build working inference end-to-end in one script. Live demo this Thu. RSVP: <https://events.redwood.com/playbook>'
- 'Bench snapshot: see how batching changes p95. Run the script to reproduce.'

Omar: snippet for README to show latency test:

```
# quick latency
./playbook/quickstart.sh --mode local && python bench/bench.py --tokens 64
```

Tess: I'll draft the blog and social copy. Can someone supply a small chart image from the bench? Omar can run bench and dump a png to `marketing/assets`.

Rita: owners list:
- Quickstart + PR -> Omar
- Bench script + sample results -> Omar + Tess
- Blog draft + GH release notes -> Tess
- Webinar runbook + slides -> Rita
- HubSpot form + routing -> Hannah

promo-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slots Wed 10am & Thu 2pm. Use `/reserve` to book.

Omar: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-playbook/pull/7  includes quickstart and bench script. Tagging @Tess.

Hannah: HS form created and automation `hs_workflow_playbook` added. Routing rules in place.

Tess: draft blog link: https://docs.google.com/draft/inference-playbook. Will share comments by EOD.

Rita: small ask to growth: can we run a short 2-day retargeting campaign to registrants who viewed pricing? Hannah: yes, will segment.

Omar: bench run results (sample): p50=85ms, p95=230ms with batch=4 on local quant model. Will add graph.

Tess: posting social assets to figma board -> <https://www.figma.com/file/ref-playbook-assets>.

Rita: great work. We'll publish the blog Mon, stream Thu, and post follow-ups Fri. Reconvene here after rehearsal.
